proposals.title: Add a 'share' definition (CPRA-style)

redline.before: third party for monetary or other valuable consideration.
redline.after: third party for monetary or other valuable consideration. "Share," "shared," or "sharing" means the same conduct by the business to a third party for cross-context behavioral advertising, whether or not for monetary or other valuable consideration.

proposals.rationale: Extends the opt-out prohibition to cover disclosures for cross-context behavioral advertising even when no consideration changes hands, closing the free-transfer and barter loopholes without touching the service-provider or consumer-directed exceptions.

lazy.title: Ban all post-opt-out disclosures (overbroad)

redline.before: from selling the consumer’s personal information after its receipt of the consumer’s direction, unless the consumer subsequently provides express authorization for the sale of the consumer’s personal information.
redline.after: from disclosing the consumer’s personal information to anyone after its receipt of the consumer’s direction.

lazy.rationale: A lazy, overbroad fix that bans every post-opt-out disclosure, including the service-provider payment processing and consumer-directed transfers the purpose contract requires to stay legal.
